selected_architecture: B — single-use operation-owned immutable terminal evidence capsule with independent public-call/lifecycle observation and read-only materialization
transaction_definition: T is the one fresh eligible backend operation admitted in the actual separately authorized approved client/public ioctl lifetime within the qualified one-use observer context.
result_definition: R is the preserved bundle anchored by a new producer-originated immutable capsule, plus exact approved-client response/image, streams/outcomes and context/observation receipts. The capsule, not legacy response lineage, supplies provenance.

provenance_relation.common_origin: All capsule projections originate in the same admitted T; no substituted lineage.
provenance_relation.client_corroboration: For complete successful bundle, relevant exported response fields/summaries and all color bytes agree with capsule. This does not prove excluded reporter implementation.

semantic_properties.P1: Actual current approved call/context and fresh non-reusable observation instance; old operation/boot records cannot qualify.
semantic_properties.P2: Accepted-event contributions must have real qualified hardware-sample origin for the admitted operation; no arbitrary supplied transition lineage.
semantic_properties.P3: Capture actual terminal qualified service result and phase of that operation.
semantic_properties.P4: Capture full color bytes from that same operation storage while retirement/readback conditions hold.
semantic_properties.P5: Private operation-owned construction structurally couples accepted state, terminal result and color; no mixed-origin writers.
semantic_properties.P6: Immutable capsule survives owner release/client exit until trusted complete protected materialization; RAM retention is not disk durability.
semantic_properties.P7: Missing/incomplete/unprovable reporting remains UNKNOWN; no success by tuple alone.
semantic_properties.P8: Possible ambiguous issuance consumes the attempt; STOP/no retry.
semantic_properties.P9: Independent permitted-source structural review and offline fault/separation qualification before any separately approved live use.

construction_invariants.I1: Qualified observer establishes actual approved public call lifetime and exactly one eligible admitted backend operation T, with continuous context. Uncertainty is invalidity.
construction_invariants.I2: Only that admission can create its private bounded evidence capsule; it is not an arbitrary response formatter.
construction_invariants.I3: Only source-matched qualified hardware-origin acceptance transitions for T can populate authoritative accepted evidence. Software claims/equal numeric sequences alone cannot.
construction_invariants.I4: Terminal writer observes actual service result/phase of T from permitted interfaces, not legacy response scalars.
construction_invariants.I5: Color writer reads T storage while retired/readback-valid and freezes all 4096 bytes before invalidation.
construction_invariants.I6: No other lifetime can write/rebind this capsule; faithful snapshots remain permitted.
construction_invariants.I7: Closure requires complete observation/no second admission; immutable retention and trusted fresh-instance materialization preserve payload origin.
construction_invariants.I8: Protected archive independently rereads actual preserved bytes; hashes alone cannot supply producer provenance.

minimum_discriminator: One actual boot/context + one qualified non-reusable observation/call/operation lifetime; no globally unique identifier or exported operation number required.
admission_rule: Permitted backend lifetime begins in independently observed active public ioctl lifetime of approved process. Use actual OS-managed lifetimes; PID equality alone is insufficient. Private operation lease couples source/acceptance/capture. Unconnected async lineage is UNKNOWN and excluded from minimum design.
invalidity_rule: Ambiguity, lost observation, second admission, source mismatch, context break or missing payload prevents valid publication. Retain terminal payload unchanged plus invalidity/partial records; never rearm after possible issuance.
capsule_contents: Actual continuous context and fresh-instance provenance
Accepted terminal ledger under qualified semantics
Full immutable 4096-byte retirement-gated color capture when available
capsule_constructor_rule: Private producer-owned construction from the admitted permitted hardware/acceptance/terminal/readback observations. Do not accept arbitrary old images, unrelated sessions or public response scalars as authoritative input.
snapshot_rule: Capture during valid source lifetime, freeze before release, retain independent ownership. A later owner allocation cannot alter/rebind snapshot. Partial capsule never valid.
materialization_contract: Independently reviewable read-only evidence channel must establish fresh-instance/current loaded-producer origin, complete loss-aware delivery, and reread verification. No specific transport/path/ABI chosen or assumed already available.
preservation_requirements: Retain complete original response and client image unchanged
Preserve capsule independently of process lifetime
Preserve stdout/stderr/process outcome and complete applicable observation receipts
Exclusive protected destinations and file/type/ownership/link checks
Partial evidence retained without a false seal
Actual saved-byte verification; manifests do not authenticate kernel origin

result_classes.SUCCESS_ATTRIBUTABLE_TERMINAL_RESULT: Closed qualified capsule bound to current T, all required accepted completion classes, actual terminal state and retired color, complete agreeing exported response/image and preserved evidence. This does not establish triangle geometry/visibility.
result_classes.EXECUTION_OBSERVED_RESULT_INCOMPLETE: Only independently attributable observed facts may be claimed; missing result/color/response/retention remains UNKNOWN.
result_classes.READBACK_PRESENT_EXECUTION_ATTRIBUTION_I: Retained pixels alone; no completion or triangle claim.
result_classes.FAILURE_HOLD_ATTRIBUTABLE: T-linked failure/HOLD evidence retained; no invented completion; STOP/no retry/reviewed recovery only.
result_classes.ISSUANCE_POSSIBLE_ATTRIBUTION_LOST: May have reached device, association/report incomplete; STOP/no retry; not NOT ATTEMPTED.
result_classes.UNKNOWN: No stronger supported facts; retain partial evidence.

negative_ioctl_rule: Local failed-call bytes stay UNAUTHORITATIVE. Independently valid capsule can establish narrower execution/failure facts, not successful returned response.
failure_survival_limit: Kernel retention may survive owner/client release, not guaranteed kernel failure or power loss. Only actually durable complete evidence supports durable claims.
freshness_requirements: Current actual boot/build/action/client and continuous public call lifetime
Fresh session and hardware/software pending source state
qualification_obligations: Review public call-to-backend causal observation and eligible admission coverage without excluded caller assumptions; async/unmatched activity yields UNKNOWN.
Fresh initial state, pending software/hardware state and delayed prior-event exclusion or UNKNOWN; old boot/operation replay rejection.
One eligible operation only: duplicate/concurrent/restarted admission invalidates evidence, never drives another operation.
Reject all cross-operation accepted-state/phase/result/color mixtures; accept faithful snapshots made while source valid after release.
Arbitrary synthetic/software event words cannot create authoritative hardware-origin evidence; preserve qualified acceptance/order semantics.
Complete response/image and summary agreement, declared producer mismatch and wrong length/truncation rejection.
Fault injection across process crash, producer failure, HOLD, copy-out and write/sync/close/readback; no retry, false success or false NOT ATTEMPTED.
Immutable payload, append-only invalidity, independent lifetime, fresh-channel provenance, exclusive protected files and originals-before-copy.
B non-rearmable lifetime proof; generation wrap/reuse tests only if C/D is later chosen.
Reproducible changed-artifact qualification and exact pin impact where required; unchanged components reused within scope.
Review that observation adds no command/request changes and does not materially perturb execution beyond reviewed diagnostic overhead; mocks do not prove live hardware/timing/visibility.

change_impact.module: YES for the selected proposed kernel-side observer/capsule instrumentation; current module unchanged and no defect claimed.
change_impact.diagnostic_image: CONDITIONAL on embedding a future changed module; current image unchanged.
change_impact.fixed_triangle_uapi_expansion: NO required; retain request/response layout where possible.
change_impact.uapi_overall: CONDITIONAL: supplemental evidence export access/representation requires its own interface review; no concrete ABI selected.
change_impact.approved_client: NO required; separate evidence reader/checker is new work, not an executor.
change_impact.new_transaction_discriminator: NO required beyond structural nonreuse; no UUID/sequence export selected.
change_impact.raw_status_retention: NO required for selected design; accepted ledger with qualified provenance suffices.

reusable_qualification: Current readiness/client approvals only for their bound current identities; historical 70/70 remains historical
future_requalification: New observer/producer/export and reader/checker implementation and integration
Changed module reproducibility/architecture/import/ABI identity qualification where dependency requires
Image construction and identity if embedded module changes
Build-specific first-owner/authority bindings for future changed identity where existing procedure requires; no automatic old PASS carryover
forbidden_claims: Synthetic capsule establishes physical hardware execution
Design completion means PRE07 live PASS
Design approval authorizes implementation or SGX
contamination_stop_rule: If a design branch requires excluded/UNKNOWN material, reconstruction, derivation, indirect recovery, historical-wrapper recreation or equivalent indirect substitution for a blocked operation, STOP that branch and return its dependency to review. Do not infer hidden behavior or obtain material through another route.
excluded_inputs_and_actions: Excluded ioctl-entry/reporting or historical wrapper contents, control flow, integration tests revealing those contents, or reconstruction hints.
Alternate representations, disassembly, indirect recovery, inferred hidden behavior or derivation from restricted material.
Equivalent indirect substitution for the blocked operation or recreation of restricted entry/reporting/wrapper implementation.
Hardware contact, live guards/logs, staging, installation, boot, recovery, client/ioctl/SGX execution or retry.
Kernel/module/UAPI/client changes, patches, builds, implementation or deployment.

exact_context.freshness: Boot and 70/70 first-owner facts are preserved historical observations, not fresh invocation guards.

design_status_scope: Sufficient constructive specification, not implemented/qualified/available live machinery or confirmation of legacy G01_prime/G02_prime.
